description: Disconnects from TIA. This is the explicit teardown for the TIA instance the serve itself created (an instance we merely ATTACHED to is only detached, never killed) — but not the only path that can end an owned instance: tia_show_ui (relaunch visible), tia_project_create, and a tia_connect needing a fresh connect also end/replace it. Ending an instance serve started would lose the unsaved changes of its projects, so if one has any the call is REFUSED with 409 `unsaved_changes` (nothing is changed) unless it carries `saveUnsavedChanges:true` (saves each modified project, then disconnects; recommended) or `discardUnsavedChanges:true` (DATA LOSS: only on an explicit human decision, never to get past the refusal; the client asks the human to confirm first); `savedProjects`/`discardedProjects` report what was saved or discarded. WARNING (Gd3): on an ATTACHED instance, /disconnect does NOT close the project (nothing to save or discard) — to RELEASE the project lock while KEEPING the TIA process alive (so the next tia_connect reuses it) use tia_project_close instead. Maps to POST /disconnect.

discardUnsavedChanges.description: DATA LOSS: close the modified project(s) WITHOUT saving; every unsaved change is lost for good. Only when a human explicitly decided to throw that work away, NEVER to get past an unsaved_changes refusal. Never together with saveUnsavedChanges.

saveUnsavedChanges.description: RECOMMENDED choice when a modified project would be closed: save every modified project this call closes, then close it. Without a flag such a call is refused with unsaved_changes and nothing is changed. Never together with discardUnsavedChanges.
